steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Library in Filter environments. Click National Library, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the display
steps.html: Find an open spot near the bookshelves. Put the Community book in the middle and the other 4 models around it.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until your whole diorama fits. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Space the models apart, so visitors can walk around each one.

vr.full: One photo that shows all 5 models in your display.

studio.title: Who Am I?
studio.look: Six people from our Contributions Wall. Each round gives clues about one of them. Read a clue, then guess who it is.
studio.do: Read the clue. Tap the person. Not sure yet? Tap Show the next clue.

game.miss: Not this person. Read all the clues again.
game.done: You named all six! Each one gave something nobody else could.

rounds.gave: A way to write the Cherokee language
rounds.ok: Yes! Sequoyah made 86 symbols, one for each sound in Cherokee.
clues: My people spoke our language, but they could not write it yet.
I made 86 symbols, one for each sound.

rounds.gave: The first woman on the U.S. Supreme Court
rounds.ok: Yes! Sandra Day O'Connor served on the Supreme Court for 24 years.
clues: I became a lawyer and then a judge.
In 1981, I became the first woman on the highest court in the country.

rounds.gave: Protected Hawaiian traditions and wrote songs
rounds.ok: Yes! Queen Liliʻuokalani wrote the song "Aloha ʻOe."
clues: I worked to protect the traditions of my people.
I was the last queen of Hawaii.

rounds.ok: Yes! Frederick Douglass escaped slavery and spoke for freedom.
clues: I started a newspaper called The North Star.
I was born enslaved in Maryland and escaped to freedom.

rounds.gave: Fair pay and respect for farm workers
rounds.ok: Yes! Cesar Chavez organized farm workers.
clues: I saw that farm workers were treated unfairly.
I organized farm workers to ask for fair pay and safer work.

rounds.ok: Yes! Maya Lin was only 21 when her design was chosen.
clues: I was still in college when my design was chosen.
I designed a black stone wall in Washington, D.C., with more than 58,000 names.

frames.lead: Pick one person. What did they give?
frames.starter: One person I would thank is ...

studio.full: All six people are named, and your 2 sentences have 20 words or more.
